data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a gross reserve release of GBP 16.7 million for prior underwriting years as of 31 December 2014, representing a 6.902% reduction of opening gross claims outstanding. This release was primarily driven by very favourable trends in incurred claims development during 2014 across all years of 2011 and prior, with the utilisation of IBNR reserves being lighter than in recent times. A specific release of GBP 8.1 million was attributed to the Property class of business. Claims from Superstorm Sandy (2012) were stable and as expected, and exposure to 2013 hailstorms, high winds, and floods was not material, contributing to the overall favourable development.
raw_causal_phrases: substantial release of reserves for prior years now available due to the very favourable trends experienced during 2014 in incurred claims development on all the years of 2011 and prior
The utilisation of the reserve for incurred but not reported claims has been lighter than in any year of recent times
The provisions for these claims established at the previous year-end compared to the present estimated ultimate costs of these claims has enabled a release of reserves
